svg.title: What a skill changes
svg.desc: The pattern these skills share, step by step. Not every skill does every step. Step 1, do the work: on your real files, data and pages. Used in every skill. Step 2, check it for real: tests, renders, a re-read of what went live. Used in Finish Work, Ambitious, Hill Climb. Step 3, get a second opinion: a second AI, usually another model, scores it. Used in Ambitious, Hill Climb, Adversarial Review, Council. Step 4, wait for your yes: before it sends, posts, buys or deploys. Used in every skill. Then the agent writes down what is proven. Sample receipt from the Finish Work guide, status blocked. Asked: update the prices and publish them True now: prices saved locally. not published: the publish token is missing. Checked: ./publish.sh: exit 1, token not set Next: get the token, then run ./publish.sh
